body:
Effort check by issue-worker-high (no claim, no branch, no code).

The "Done means" of this issue is larger than effort:high:

- Slice 3 and slice 4 add new tool kinds and new machine kinds (laser, waterjet). The issue says that they can need their own research issues. Research-shaped work is effort:max by the AGENTS.md table.
- The full scope touches the tools crate, the motion crate (plasma generation and new CL records), the app (commands, project file, MCP), the UI (tool page table) and two or more posts. It also adds new verification laws.

I raised the label from effort:high to effort:max. I did not claim the issue.

Recommendation: split this issue into one sub-issue for each slice ("Part of #1521"). Slice 1 (cut-data rows on the plasma torch, project file round trip, undoable commands, MCP tool) and slice 2 (plasma generation and the Tormach post use the row, thickness refusal, edge-start rule) are each effort:high work. Slices 3 and 4 are effort:max until their research is done.
